author: Kif Leswing
title: Apple is getting crushed after analysts predict that iPhone unit sales will shrink next year - which is the same time it will stop disclosing iPhone sales (AAPL)
text: Apple is getting crushed after analysts predict that iPhone unit sales will shrink next year — which is the same time it will stop disclosing iPhone sales (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Nov 12, 2018, 1:05 pm Apple shares are sliding on Monday after a series of bad data points for iPhone demand. JP Morgan analysts said that iPhone unit sales could decline on an annual basis in both 2018 and 2019. TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo cut his forecast for iPhone XR shipments from 100 million…
